Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Description of Service: Proposal for Annual Maintenance contract for Exide battery installed at Panchet Hydel Station on OEM basis for the period of Two years. A. Scope of Work for Maintenance of Exide makes Battery Banks installed at Panchet Hy del Power Stations for a period of Two years. The objective of the contract is to maintain reliability & readiness of the battery banks for providing m aximum back-up in case of failure of AC supply. The OEM M/s Exide shall depute their service experts four monthly basis for necessary trouble-shooting/rectification measures & health assessment of the b attery banks (including replacement of cells or various parts of the cells), submit their report to DVC i ncluding necessary guidelines for maintaining healthiness of battery system. Detail scope of works is given below: 1) The period of the contract will be for Two years for schedule/preventive maintenance of Batter y bank. The visit of Exide representative will be on 4 monthly basis for maintenance of battery bank. In a single visit M/s Exide will carry out maintenance of all battery banks covered in the scope of this contract. (Duration of stay of service personnel will depend on the nature of the j ob) 2) During the visit, the OEM’s personnel should carry out the health assessment of the individual cells including measurement & recording of the specific gravity, voltage of individual cells, ins pection of cell internals, tuning of float & boost voltage/current, etc. They ascertain the healthi ness of the battery banks and furnish healthiness certificate for each battery bank after compl etion of visit. 3) Any small defects noticed should be rectified during the visit itself such as if a single cell is fou nd faulty during the visit, it must be replaced or repaired by the service personnel. They will al so ensure the readiness of the spare battery for replacement. 4) Service personnel shall top up the battery with acid as per requirement. The supply of Acid or DM water will be in the scope of DVC. 5) Checking & Rectification (if necessary) of faulty cells of the battery banks, including replacem ent with new cell. 6) Necessary testing/Checking such as Battery Earth fault identification, impedance measureme nt etc. if any during attending the fault. 7) All the sulphation at the terminals & cable end interface & any deposit on the cell internal will have to be removed & cleaned. 8) M/s Exide shall conduct the Capacity Test of each battery bank once in a year, as per directio n of EIC, for each battery bank. Suitable external load, as per requirement, shall be provided by DVC for conducting the test. 9) Minor items such as vent plug, petroleum jelly etc. are in the scope of the contractor. 10) Major spares such as Spare Cells, Acid, DM Water etc required for rectification work will be pr ovided by DVC.

11) Service engineer for schedule/preventive maintenance must be deputed within one week of r eceiving intimation from DVC representative. 12) In case of emergency/breakdown service-engineer should have to be deployed within 48 hrs o f receiving the intimation from DVC. Any breakdown which arises in between two regular servi ce calls shall be attended by the contractor on priority and without any extra cost. 13) However, any other work not mentioned specifically but considered essential for healthiness of the DC battery bank shall be deemed included in the scope of this contract. List of Battery Banks at Hydel Power Stations covered under the sc ope of this Contract are: Hydel Station Type of Battery Bank Number of Banks 220YKP-17, 200 AH 2 Panchet Hydel Station 24V, YKP-13, 150 AH 1 B.
